body: All 20 Steps built through mitosis (six passes; lanes 0, 4, 7 and 8 needed orchestrator test fixes after the receipts hook blocked the builders, lane 7 was once killed externally with exit 143). Every MSP gated pass (63 of 63 acceptance properties). An independent code review per branch found no blockers on foundation, sync and settings and one blocker on the viewers branch: portrait video rotated twice on Android, because video_player_android 2.12.2 already reports VideoPlayerValue.size upright with a separate rotationCorrection (ImageReader path under Impeller Vulkan). All review findings were fixed with red-then-green tests (fix agents per branch plus orchestrator fixes), the foundation fix was merged into the three stacked branches, and each branch passed the full suite at its head. Four draft PRs opened through pr.mjs: SatanshuMishra/field-notes#291 (foundation, base main), #292 (viewers and day panel), #293 (sync), #294 (settings), the last three stacked on mitosis/surface-foundation. No two of #292-#294 change the same file. The old viewer's mute toggle was removed (no mute in the spec's control list).
